description: This Scala trait defines an interface for setting and removing entries in a logger's MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context). It provides methods for adding individual or multiple MDC entries, and removing entries by key, enabling structured logging enhancements.

classes.name: MdcEntrySettable
classes.description: A trait that specifies methods for adding, setting, and removing MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entries for loggers, parametrized by the logger type.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds a single MDC entry (key-value pair) to the logger or returns a new logger instance for chaining.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds two MDC entries simultaneously for the logger, supporting method chaining.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds three MDC entries simultaneously for the logger, supporting method chaining.

methods.name: withMdcEntry (varargs)
methods.description: Adds multiple MDC entries passed as varargs (entries and further entries), returning a logger for chaining.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry identified by the given key from the logger.
